title: P18-A canonical objective_relation — the coordination layer's atomic fact between objectives in one business
description: P18-A: canonical objective_relation + ObjectiveRelationService — substrate for portfolio/parallel/handoff/duties/recovery. Closed kind vocabulary (DEPENDS_ON, CONFLICTS, SUPERSEDES); ACTIVE→SUSPENDED⇄ACTIVE→REVOKED terminal+idempotent; closed action vocabulary. Bilateral authority: actor = operator:<ref> = owner_authority_id of BOTH endpoints at mint/control AND created_by re-checked against CURRENT owners at re-proof. business_id derived from canonical objectives; strict ObjectiveAuthorityService.get endpoints. DEPENDS_ON acyclicity at mint AND RESUME over non-REVOKED edges. Idempotent mint per (from,to,kind) — CONFLICTS symmetric; dedup after authority. create()/control() inside store.immediate — check+put+event atomic, cross-connection serialized. STRICT/LENIENT re-proof split: writes (dedup + cycle edges) enumerate strict — any corruption (entity hash/key/version, event tail, endpoint payload, store fault) propagates loudly so a corrupted-but-real row can never silently truncate the canonical set into a dup mint or cycle admission; reads enumerate lenient — corrupt rows isolate-and-skip, siblings still serve; semantic unproven-ness (fabricated rows, broken/forged chains, amended owners) returns null in both modes so fabrications can't DoS mints. Budget trips (PROOF_LIMIT) always propagate. Re-proof: digest + entityPage storage-key binding + strict endpoints + business + bilateral current-owner + FULL event tail (CREATED first, pinned new_state=ACTIVE + identity pins + old_state=null, legal chained STATE hops, ends at row state). upstreamOf/conflictsWith dedup'd, deterministic code-unit order. dedup_key+note validated/bounded. store.ts: JSON.parse wraps → IntegrityError-with-key on entityPage/get/list/verifiedEvent/listEvidence/planRevisions/listAllRaw (was bare SyntaxError). P18-A inert: no admission/scheduling/UI consumer. Codex-only.
